name: Game Engine Architecture
purpose: Design modular engine subsystems, memory layout, and tick cycles.
inputs: Engine subsystem graph, ECS/query model, threading model, and ownership boundaries
Target CPU, GPU, memory budgets, determinism contract, and benchmark workloads
Asset formats, spatial scale, entity counts, and supported platforms
outputs: Validated subsystem and dependency architecture with explicit data flow
ECS storage, scheduler, pooling, and resource-lifecycle implementation
Determinism, race, memory, and frame-time benchmark evidence
stop_conditions: Hot path meets allocation, memory, and frame budgets with no data races
Replay state is identical across repeated runs and supported worker counts
Token budget exhausted or engine target hardware is unavailable
